desc: The Western Crosstrail Fixed Blade knife strikes a balance between its stylized aesthetic and functional capabilities. Featuring a 4.25" Titanium Bonded 420 Steel blade bonded with Titanium this adds extra resistance to rust and corrosion while also making the blade up to 3x harder than untreated steel. The extra hardness affords edge retention as well. The handle is made of Delrin, an extremely durable and stable crystalline plastic used to resemble stag or antler. Includes a sheath and belt loop.
